integrity: The exact factorial-moment lemma, scaling limits, and limiting cross-band covariance are proved in RESULT.md. Finite code checks use complete enumeration for n=2..6 and do not certify asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: The 1994 article was accessible only via abstract/references; a dated 2004 full-text preprint was read. The a=0 (unchanged-map) case is pre-existing. Priority over unindexed equivalent noise-thinning literature is unverified. Results concern common identical directed cycles, not merely joint periodic vertices; no convergence rate is proved.
title: A Poisson–non-Poisson crossover for cycles preserved by noisy random mappings
